name: EmptyState
summary: What a list, table, card or view shows when it has nothing: in the content's own wrapper at its least size, it says what would be here, why it's empty and what to do. The wrapper's toolbar, search and Add stay where they are. Not for loading (Skeleton) or a failure to load (Alert with Retry); not for a table cell (a dash with the name "None").
a11y: The title is a heading in the page's outline (view and section), read before the reason and the action. The silhouette is `aria-hidden`. With `announce` the title is said once through the polite announcer, for an empty result the person caused; a view that opens empty is read in order instead. After the last item is removed, move focus to the action or the title.

props.name: reason
props.description: Why it's empty, which sets nothing visible but documents the tone: `first-use` (never had anything: welcoming), `cleared` (the person emptied it), `no-results` (a search or filter: plain, names the query), `no-access` (it exists, this person can't see it: plain) or `done` (zero as success: a short celebration). A failure to load is never an empty state: show an Alert at that scope.

props.name: scope
props.description: The wrapper it fills: a whole `view`'s content area, a `section` (card, panel) or a `component` (menu, picker).

props.name: title
props.description: Names the state: "No projects yet", "No projects match “budget”", "All caught up".

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The title's level in the page's outline. Defaults to 2 for a view, 3 for a section; a component has no heading.

props.name: children
props.description: The reason and the next step, in a sentence or two.

props.name: actions
props.description: The way out: one Button or Link that fixes it ("Create a project", "Clear filters"), quiet when many show at once.

props.name: silhouette
props.description: A faint, still outline of the content to come (decorative, hidden from screen readers); never on `no-access`.

props.name: illustration
props.description: **Under test (VS4, AF11): only the EmptyState review story uses it; no template does until the check passes.** A small decorative spot illustration of what will appear, in the silhouette's place (it replaces the silhouette), at its own CSS size (`width` × `height`) and never wider than the silhouette; hidden from screen readers.

props.name: announce
props.description: Says the title through the polite announcer when it appears: only when the person caused it (a search, a filter, clearing).
